desc: Prove optimality of the canonical left-to-right insertion-sort reduced word using commutation and braid transformations.
Derive an \(O(N\log N)\) Fenwick-tree algorithm for the insertion-sort sequence and its total weighted cost.
Validate the result against the samples and exhaustive small permutations, especially cases involving braid choices.
Implement the proven algorithm in Python with efficient I/O and 64-bit-safe arithmetic.
